sources.summary:

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 数百名Google员工经Alphabet Workers Union请愿，要求撤回明年起对关闭Gemini AI工具的学校切断Search访问的政策，New York City、Los Angeles和Chicago已讨论替代搜索引擎。

en.title: Google employees call on the company not to punish schools reluctant to adopt AI
en.reason: Hundreds of Google workers petitioned through the Alphabet Workers Union to retract a policy starting next year that would cut Search access for schools disabling Gemini AI tools, as New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago discuss alternative search engines.
